seo_title: Pacific Grove Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 9 Events, 4 Free
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Pacific Grove, California for 2026: 9 family events, 4 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Pacific Grove for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (the Holiday Tree Lighting in Jewell Park) through December 31 (the last night of Candy Cane Lane), with the Holiday Parade of Lights (December 3), Holiday Wreathmaking at the Pacific Grove Museum of Natural History (December 5), Holiday at the Inns (December 8) and Breakfast with Santa at Asilomar (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Pacific Grove

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Pacific Grove
  • 4 free events, including the Holiday Tree Lighting, the Holiday Parade of Lights, Stillwell's Holiday in the Park and the Holiday Tree Lighting at Asilomar
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Asilomar (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Tree Lighting in Jewell Park (November 30), the Holiday Parade of Lights on Lighthouse Avenue (December 3) and the Holiday Tree Lighting at Asilomar (December 2)
  • Lights and crafts: Candy Cane Lane (December 5 to 31), Holiday at the Inns (December 8, $30), Holiday Wreathmaking at the Pacific Grove Museum of Natural History (December 5) and Holiday Cooking and Crafts with Kids at Happy Girl Kitchen (December 22)
  • Season: November 30 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Pacific Grove families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Salinas, which covers the Salinas Valley and Monterey County nearby.
